papers.title: Effect of heat treatment on microstructural heterogeneity and mechanical properties of 1%C-CoCrFeMnNi alloy fabricated by selective laser melting

corresponding_authors.name: Hyoung Seop Kim
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for High Entropy Alloys, Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH), Pohang 37673, Republic of Korea

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了非生物医学用高熵合金的SLM制备与热处理，未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡，与AM生物医学方向关联度低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface roughness/osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM制备的1%C-CoCrFeMnNi合金微观结构及力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备合金并进行不同温度的热处理，结合微观表征和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著影响微观结构均匀性和力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 拉伸测试与微观结构分析验证了热处理效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of heat treatment on the microstructural heterogeneity and mechanical properties of a 1%C-CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: The alloy was fabricated by SLM and subjected to various heat treatment conditions, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered the microstructural homogeneity and mechanical properties of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Tensile tests and microstructural analysis validated the influence of heat treatment.

papers.title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical property of W/316L multi-material fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Engineering, China University of Geosciences, Wuhan 430074, China

corresponding_authors.name: Keyu Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Material Processing and Die & Mould Technology, School of Materials Science and Engineering, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan 430074, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了W/316L多材料的选择性激光熔化及其热处理，与生物医学植入物应用无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant applications, stress shielding, osseointegration, or fatigue; the material combination (W/316L) is not relevant to hip implants or bone-interfacing devices.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究热处理对SLM制备的W/316L多材料微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM成形的W/316L样品进行不同温度的热处理，并进行微观表征和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 热处理提高了界面结合强度但降低了塑性，优化了显微组织。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜、能谱分析和拉伸/压缩等力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to understand how post-process heat treatment alters the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of additively manufactured W/316L multi-material components.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melted W/316L samples were subjected to various heat treatment conditions and analyzed using microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment enhanced interfacial bonding strength but reduced ductility, with microstructural changes including diffusion layer formation.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via SEM/EDS microstructural analysis and mechanical tests (tensile, compression).

papers.title: Periodontal and Peri-Implant Diseases and Systemically Administered Statins: A Systematic Review.
papers.abstract: Hyperlipidemia is a well-recognized risk factor for cardiovascular disease, which, in turn, acts as a contributory factor in periodontitis development. Periodontitis has been associated with benign tumors and cancers and withseveral disorders, including hyperlipidemia. Correspondingly, periodontal treatment may exert a positive effect on lipid metabolism, although opposite evidence has also been reported. As a counterpart, the therapy for hyperlipidemia, conventionally based on statins, has been proposed to positively affect periodontal conditions, mainly due to statin pleiotropic effects, reducing periodontal inflammation and promoting osseointegration. Therefore, the present systematic review aimed to evaluate, in subjects with untreated periodontitis and peri-implant disease (Population), the effect of routine systemically administered statins (Intervention), compared to non-statin use (Comparison), on periodontal parameters around natural teeth and implants (Outcome). Discordant results were found in periodontal parameters, and the current lack of such data related to peri-implant tissues and to alveolar bone loss highlights the need for further studies on the topic, potentially paving the way for a more comprehensive approach to periodontitis and peri-implantitis management. Indeed, the validation of the beneficial effect provided by systemically delivered statins on periodontal and peri-implant tissues may direct recall scheduling, predict response to therapy and, therefore, guide treatment strategies of periodontal and peri-implant treatments in statin users.

llm.relevance_to_user: 此论文为关于他汀类药物与牙周疾病的系统综述，与AM生物医学材料方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical systematic review on statins and periodontal disease; it contains no additive manufacturing, no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no stress shielding analysis, and no biomedical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估系统性他汀类药物对牙周和种植体周围疾病的影响
summary_zh.method: 系统综述比较他汀使用者与非使用者的牙周参数
summary_zh.result: 牙周参数结果不一致，缺乏种植体周围组织和骨丢失数据
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of systemically administered statins on periodontal and peri-implant parameters in diseased patients.
summary_en.method: A systematic review comparing periodontal outcomes between statin users and non-users.
summary_en.result: Discordant periodontal findings and insufficient data on peri-implant tissues and bone loss highlight the need for further research.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; it is a literature review.
